subject: Offer calibration: L5 Manager vs L6 Staff for Alex Rivera
messages:
From: Lily Anderson <lily@talentbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Candidate Alex Rivera - proposed level/title and comp

Hi Marissa —

Thanks again for the quick sync last week. Alex Rivera (resume attached) is excited about the Data Platform role. We ran comp checks and the client is expecting an L5 Manager title on the offer, but Alex’s background shows several Staff-level IC contributions (led cross-org infra project, published infra perf improvements).

Proposed package from the client side:
- Title: L5 Manager, Data Platform
- Base: $205,000
- Target OTE (base + bonus): $221,000
- Equity: 0.10% over 4 years, 1-year cliff
- Start window: May 4 - May 18

Attachments: resume_alex_rivera.pdf; comp_band_engineering_q1_2026.pdf

Can you confirm how you want to position the title (Manager vs Staff) and whether the proposed comp aligns with Redwood bands? Also noted the hiring manager (Rohan) would like a slightly higher band if we push for L6.

Lily
TalentBridge

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Candidate Alex Rivera - proposed level/title and comp

Thanks Lily — forwarding to hiring committee for quick calibration.

Quick summary for internal context:
- Candidate: Alex Rivera (ex-WideScale), strong infra + people leadership on a ~4-engineer platform team; recent role had IC + informal lead responsibilities.
- Client/recruiter proposing L5 Manager title at $205k base + 0.10% equity.
- Hiring manager Rohan feels candidate could meet L6 IC bar given impact, but Rohan also needs someone to run a small team (manager responsibility).

Ask for this thread:
1) Title calibration: L5 (Manager) vs L6 (Staff IC). Pros/cons below.
2) If we go L5 Manager, what band (mid/upper) do we offer to avoid regressions?
3) Any headcount or budget constraints we need to surface before I confirm to the recruiter.

Pros for L5 Manager:
- Matches hiring manager’s org structure (need a people lead).
- Clear org reporting and compensation banding for managers.

Pros for L6 Staff IC:
- Reflects candidate impact and seniority; may help retention if we give Staff-level influence + IC career path.
- Harder to reconcile with immediate org need for a people manager.

Initial recommendation from me: offer L5 Manager, mid-to-upper band (to be competitive) with a documented growth plan to L6 (technical ladder). If group prefers L6, we should convert title to Senior Staff and clarify that this role will not have direct reports initially — and ensure comp moves to L6 band.

I’m attaching Redwood comp band extract so we can pick a concrete base range.

- Marissa
Director, Talent Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Candidate Alex Rivera - proposed level/title and comp

Marissa —

On Mon, Mar 16, 2026 at 11:00 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick summary for internal context:
> - Candidate: Alex Rivera (ex-WideScale), strong infra + people leadership on a ~4-engineer platform team; recent role had IC + informal lead responsibilities.
> - Client/recruiter proposing L5 Manager title at $205k base + 0.10% equity.

I reviewed Alex’s resume and the notes from Rohan. My take: Alex is right on the cusp between L5 Manager and L6 Staff. Concrete points:
- Technical depth: demonstrated (systems perf work, infra scaling) — L6-level tech footprint possible.
- People leadership: managed small teams informally; not a long-tenured people manager.
- Cross-org influence: medium; led 2 cross-functional projects.

Recommendation: offer as L5 Manager but place base at the upper quartile for L5 ($200k–$215k range). Make the offer conditional on a written 6-month objectives plan with measurable technical milestones that, if met, triggers a calibrated conversion discussion to L6 (title + comp uplift).

If hiring team insists on L6: we need to adjust comp to L6 mid band ($230k–$250k) and clear justification for the headcount classification change. My preference is to keep org structure (Manager) and avoid paying L6 rates unless the role will unequivocally drive company-level impact.

-Markus
Director of Engineering

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 14:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Candidate Alex Rivera - proposed level/title and comp

Folks —

HR checks done:
- Band confirmation: L5 base band (mid-to-upper) aligns with $195k–$215k. Equity allocation of 0.10% is within L5 ranges for Data Platform.
- Headcount: HC-3421 shows an approved headcount for Data Platform (Manager) that covers salary up to $220k. I’ve attached the headcount approval screenshot (headcount_HC-3421.png).
- Offer package: we can sign for $210k base + 10% target bonus + 0.10% equity without additional approvals. Anything above $220k base or an L6 band requires VP sign-off (Laura).

Next steps for recruiter: please prepare an offer letter with L5 Manager title, $210k base, 10% bonus, 0.10% equity. Include a 6-month milestone plan and clear criteria for a promotion conversation to L6 if objectives are met.

Mina

Approved Offer (final):
- Title: L5 Manager, Data Platform
- Base: $210,000
- Target bonus: 10%

@Lily: please prepare the offer letter using the attached template (offer_template_L5_Manager.docx) and route the DocuSign to Alex. @Marissa: once signed, please set a 6-month calibration checkpoint (calendar invite) and capture objectives in the candidate file (GH-5123).
